incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: billing.metering.token-drift detected in prod. Severity: P2. Symptoms: token counts diverging between realtime emitter and billing ledger; customer overage flags firing. Please ack and join.
maria-oncall: acked. I'm oncall. I'm jumping into the emitter and ledger dashboards now.
sam-sre: I'm oncall-sre, watching. First check: any deploys in the last 15m? @telemetry-bot any deploy events?
telemetry-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment: service/emitter v2.4.1 at 1801234489 by jordan-eng — status: success
maria-oncall: ok there's a deploy ~1m before alerts. Pulling logs from emitter-1 pod.
jordan-eng: THAT deploy had a change to batching/seq-window; I pushed a soft toggle. Rolling it back if needed.
billing-ops: customers: a handful got automatic overage emails. We're seeing three flagged accounts in the dashboard.
maria-oncall: looking at counts: emitter shows ~1.8x tokens for recent windows vs ledger. Querying ledger for last 10m.
maria-oncall: SQL I ran:
```
SELECT window_start, SUM(tokens) as ledger_tokens
FROM billing.tallies
WHERE window_start >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
sam-sre: emitter metric: `emitter.tokens_emitted` spike at 1801234478. Ledger ingestion shows steady ingestion; suspect emitter is double-emitting on retry path. Checking Redis ack keys.
jordan-eng: I have the toggle ready. If emitter double-emits on replay, we need to flip `ENABLE_BATCH_DEDUPE=false` back to true. Prepping rollback.
maria-oncall: quick mitigation: disable customer overage emails and mute the alerts so we don't spam customers while we investigate. @billing-ops can you stop outbound overage notifications?
billing-ops: pausing outbound overage notifications now. Marking affected emails as "suspended" in the UI. :white_check_mark:
maria-oncall: Sam, can you apply a hotfix to stop duplicate emits? If quick rollback available, do it.
sam-sre: Applying config rollback to emitter config map (kubectl apply). Command:
```
kubectl set env deployment/emitter ENABLE_BATCH_DEDUPE=true -n prod
```
sam-sre: done. pod rolling restart kicked off. Watching emitter logs.
jordan-eng: also revoked the soft toggle on the feature flag we shipped. Should be safe.
telemetry-bot: metric update: `emitter.tokens_emitted` returned to baseline at 1801234590
maria-oncall: ledger vs emitter counts now within 1.03x. Good. Leave alerts muted for another 5m while we validate backfill correctness.
billing-ops: prepping a customer note draft in case we need to notify: short, apologetic, explain counts briefly, say we're pausing billing while we reconcile.
katie-pm: agree on short note. We should only notify if reconciliation shows customers billed incorrectly. Keep wording conservative.
maria-oncall: next steps: 1) run reconciliation job to compute drift and backfill ledger delta; 2) compute list of customers who would have been over-threshold; 3) hold billing for those customers until confirm. Sam — can you trigger the one-off reconcile?
sam-sre: Triggering reconcile job `scripts/reconcile-token-diffs --window 15m --dry-run` now. Logs:
```
[1801234600] reconcile: starting dry-run
[1801234612] reconcile: computed total emitter_tokens=1,203,451 ledger_tokens=668,002 delta=535,449
[1801234618] reconcile: estimated impacted_accounts=3 (ids: acct_42, acct_128, acct_999)
[1801234624] reconcile: dry-run complete; no writes performed
```
maria-oncall: results match billing-ops' flagged customers. Good catch. Since delta is significant, keep billing suspended for impacted accounts and schedule automated credit if necessary.
billing-ops: placing holds on acct_42 acct_128 acct_999 in the billing system. Will not invoice for current window. Creating support tickets.
katie-pm: let's draft a proactive customer notification template if we need to send it. Assigning to @billing-ops to own external comms.
jordan-eng: will open a PR with stricter emitter idempotency checks and add a unit test for the retry path. I'll link the PR in the followup postmortem.
maria-oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2026 with timeline + mitigation. We will keep the thread for final handoff to the day team. Summary for handoff: root cause is double-emits introduced by recent batching toggle, rollback restored parity, we paused outbound overage emails, held billing for impacted accounts, dry-run reconciliation validated delta. Next: run real reconcile and apply ledger backfill during quiet hours.
incidents-bot: Incident status updated: P2 -> stable. Handoff to day shift at 1801234625. Keep any long-running postmortem notes in INC-2026."
